description: Type, read and hear the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) with NVDA. Press NVDA+Alt+I and your normal keys type IPA symbols, with each symbol named as you type it. NVDA says IPA symbols by name in every program. Press Space after a transcription to hear it as a real word, through eSpeak or IBM TTS. Turn on fluent reading with NVDA+Alt+F to hear the transcriptions in a document as words. Learn it all by ear with the trainer: press NVDA+Alt+P, or open the NVDA menu, then Tools, then Accessible Phonetics, where you also find the user guide. Covers British English (RP) and supports American English.
changelog: New Accessible Phonetics submenu in the NVDA Tools menu, with the trainer, the user guide, a link for reporting problems, and a way to reset trainer progress. The user guide now has a full symbol list with the key for each symbol, and explains installing from the Add-on Store.
